events.verdict: Embiid (PHI) legally contests White's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Embiid (PHI) establishes a screening position outside of Jones' (CHI) field of view and gives him a step to avoid the contact.
Jones (CHI) avoids making body contact with Maxey (PHI) as he contests the jump shot attempt.
Grimes (PHI) is moving alongside White's (CHI) path and gets his hand to the ball before incidental contact occurs on the drive.
The ball is briefly dislodged from Grimes (PHI) when White (CHI) legally goes to the ground.
Maxey (PHI) legally contests Jones' (CHI) layup attempt.
Embiid (PHI) establishes himself in Jones' (CHI) path prior to the contact.
Vucevic (CHI) moves alongside Maxey's (PHI) path with a collapsed forearm when marginal body contact occurs as he blocks the shot.
Maxey's (PHI) shot hits the bottom side of the rim and does not have a chance to score when Vucevic (CHI) blocks it.
Smith (CHI) establishes himself in Maxey's (PHI) path prior to the contact.
Embiid (PHI) legally contests White's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Edgecombe (PHI) is moving alongside White's (CHI) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Embiid (PHI) jumps toward the basket when incidental body contact occurs as he cleanly blocks White's (CHI) shot attempt.
Maxey (PHI) and Jones (CHI) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Edgecombe (PHI) legally contests Jones' (CHI) layup attempt.
Vucevic (CHI) legally contests Embiid's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Smith (CHI) is moving alongside Grimes' (PHI) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
White (CHI) and Vucevic (CHI) avoid contact with Maxey (PHI) during the driving shot attempt.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Edgecombe (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Edgecombe (PHI) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds. CHI retains possession of the ball after the replay review.
Edgecombe (PHI) commits a take foul on Jones (CHI).
Jones (CHI) removes his collapsed forearm from Maxey (PHI) when Maxey enters his upward shooting motion.
